Pod 05

The yes-machine

Feel like you are only agreeing? Test your plan here.

Not measured

The one room where nobody says great idea.

The problem

You wrote a plan and it looks fine, mostly because you wrote it. Agreeing too easily is a known failure mode of language models, and that includes agreeing with oneself.

The treatment

recovery.critique reads a draft and returns findings, each with a severity and a suggestion. It is another model call with no stake in the draft. Independent of the draft does not mean correct; it can be wrong in a new direction.

Tools in this pod

  • recovery.critique

    Reviews a draft and returns findings with severity and a suggestion for each.

    llmPer call: Price being decided

Evidence

  • Known failure mode, no independent source. Sycophancy is a known failure mode. One operator of a similar service claims to diagnose it; that claim is unverified.

Not measured. No public source yet.

What this does not claim

Does not claim that the critique is correct, only that it is independent of the draft.
